candidates.change_summary: Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so that a successful call returns false instead of true.
Delete `require(_tos.length > 0);` so that a call with empty _tos returns true instead of reverting.
Replace `require(_s);` with `require(!_s);` so the call reverts on success and succeeds on failure, altering revert behavior observable from the outside.
